SELECT fish_date_season AS season, fish_date_doy/10*10 AS doy_bucket, cls,
  SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS pooled_share, COUNT(*) AS boat_days
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 250 AND 310 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter','overnight')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY season, doy_bucket, cls
